question: Average age of group A of 20 students is 40 years. Average age of group B of 40 students is 'x' years. Combined average age of group A and group B is 50 years. What is the value of 'x'?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Ratio of students in **Group A** to **Group B** = 20 : 40 = 1 : 2 Deviation of **Group A** from **Combined Average** = 50 − 40 = 10 Since the student ratio is 1 : 2, the deviation ratio is inverse, i.e., 2 : 1. If 2 units = 10, then 1 unit = 5. Value of x = 50 + 5 = 55. **∴ The correct answer is 55.**
